name: Cyprus — Cypriot parties
intro: compare it with Cypriot political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Cyprus: those represented in the parliament (Vouli ton Antiprosopon) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Vouli ton Antiprosopon) after the 2021 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 56 members. A more recent election is not yet reflected in these seats; the party list includes parties that are strong in current polls. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

AKEL.name: AKEL
AKEL.priorities: Reunification of Cyprus, Workers' rights and wages, Public services
AKEL.description: Communist-rooted party, one of the two largest in Cyprus, which strongly supports reunification with the Turkish Cypriot community.

Greens.name: Movement of Ecologists – Citizens' Cooperation
Greens.description: Cyprus's green party, focused on the environment, water and good governance.

EDEK.name: Movement for Social Democracy (EDEK)
EDEK.description: Social-democratic party with a hard line on the Cyprus problem.

Volt.name: Volt Cyprus
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

DIKO.name: Democratic Party (DIKO)
DIKO.priorities: National sovereignty, Pensions and the elderly
DIKO.description: Centrist party and frequent kingmaker, sceptical of UN reunification plans.

ALMA.name: ALMA – Citizens for Cyprus
ALMA.priorities: Fighting corruption, Rule of law, Transparency and digital rights
ALMA.description: Anti-corruption party founded by former auditor-general Odysseas Michaelides.

DD.name: Direct Democracy
DD.priorities: Direct democracy, Transparency and digital rights
DD.description: Movement of YouTuber Fidias Panayiotou, elected MEP as an independent in 2024, promising to let citizens vote online on every decision.

DISY.name: Democratic Rally (DISY)
DISY.priorities: Reunification of Cyprus, Competitiveness and growth, Deeper European integration
DISY.description: The main centre-right party, pro-European and pro-business, and historically open to a federal settlement of the Cyprus problem.

ELAM.name: ELAM (National Popular Front)
ELAM.priorities: Reducing immigration, National identity, National sovereignty
ELAM.description: Nationalist party with roots in Greece's Golden Dawn, which has grown quickly on the issue of migration.
